horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Dïïjoma, hombre-serpiente y águila. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P12 — Nibagïeño · cuidadora de la boa. 
Reference 2: V06 — Dïïjoma — boa exteriorizada. 
Reference 3: L04 — Laguna — crecimiento y retirada. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide tranquil green lagoon at dawn. ONE complete Nibagïeño matching P12, fully covered in her raw-fibre garment, kneels on a low bank and offers a small plain white starch-paper portion in a shallow fibre container toward ONE great natural boa matching V06. Her hands remain outside the mouth; no swallowing person or violent attack. The boa's entire thick curved body, blunt head and tail remain visible along the water. One impossibility: concentric lifted lagoon shoreline sheets visibly enlarge around the creature, as if the basin grows with the nourished serpent. No extra daughter, father, modern dish, neon water or snake horns.

VISIBLE CHECK: Cuidadora vestida alimenta una boa entera; la orilla se amplía por estratos.

vertical.escena:
Use case: image editing. Edit OUR OWN AI-GENERATED paper-cut original, reference image 1. Make one independent full-bleed artwork in vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536.

CORRECTION:
Pull the camera BACK by about 22 percent, revealing more surrounding sky and low forest. Show the ENTIRE eagle with both FULL yarumo-shaped wings, every wing lobe and all feather tips safely inside the canvas with visible air around them, including the rightmost wing tip. Preserve the central eagle, yarumo wing construction, maloca below, light and paper material. No added people or symbols.

Preserve expressive physical matte cardstock, actual separated layer shadows, pale cut cross-sections, hand-cut curves, folded feather vanes and leaf midribs. Quiet natural paper-plane faces, no CGI, plastic or digital painting. The environment continues beyond all four borders; no frame, plinth or specimen-sheet layout. No printed text. Every principal whole body, head, hand, foot, wing and ornament tip must remain inside the canvas. Retain the original color relationships and traditional fibre covers. These are original editorial illustrations, not certified traditional symbols. No private photo, real-person likeness or ritual instructions.

MYTH: Dïïjoma, hombre-serpiente y águila. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: B03 — Yarumo · hoja y raíz. 
Reference 2: V06 — Dïïjoma — boa exteriorizada. 
Reference 3: V07 — Dïïjoma — águila de yarumo. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE whole pale-green lobed YARUMO LEAF is the dominant carrier on deep indigo paper. Its upper lobes lift and become feather-like cut blades, while its lower curled stem projects ONE coiled-serpent SHADOW downward. Two perspectives meet within a single leaf: flight above, inward coil below. This is an original editorial metaphor for the two transformations and the limits of power. No two literal monsters, person, skull, mandala, medicine or written instructions. Whole leaf and entire coil shadow remain visible, subtle emerald/cream/charcoal contrasts, tangible lifted paper and clear negative space.

VISIBLE CHECK: Una hoja une vanos de pluma arriba y sombra de serpiente abajo.
